description: Oracle HTTP Server web telemetry covering OHS access logs (Common and Combined formats), OHS error logs, and EBS Forms/Reports proxy access logs. Typical forwarding: file-beat relay from OHS log directories or syslog relay from the web tier. Common-format access log variant is actionable (source definition complete, fixture capture deferred); remaining variants blocked on source-shape evidence. Operator action required: provide fixture events before any variant can be promoted.
